Name: Craftable Prismatic Shard and Stardrop Recipes
Author: FaeDine
Description:
[b]UPDATE: Haven't played Stardew Valley in awhile, but came back and tested this and it works fine in Stardew 1.6. This is a really simple mod and I don't see any reason it would break on future versions unless there were major changes to Content Patcher.
[/b]

I saw a similar mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5148]Craftable Stardrops[/url] but that one didn't work correctly for me (unlocked at level 1) so I made my own. Credit to Snoresville for the idea.

Adds a recipe for crafting Prismatic Shards Stardrops.

By default the Stardrop recipe is learned at Combat Level 9 and takes 25 Prismatic Shards.

By default the Prismatic Shard recipe is learned at Mining Level 9 and takes one of each of the 7 gems.

[s]This pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7064]Craftable Prismatic Shards[/url] on which I based the code.[/s] I thought a recipe using the 7 gems for a Prismatic Shard made more sense, so I included them in this mod.
